home.stepVerificationText: Confirm your identity by uploading a document. It unlocks withdrawals and raises limits.
home.stepVerificationPending: Documents are under review — usually within one business day.
home.stepDepositText: Your demo account is already funded. Real deposits open once the payment provider is connected.
home.stepTradeText: Open the terminal and make your first trade with demo funds — risk-free.
home.balanceDemoNote: Demo funds. Real accounts arrive with payment operations.
home.marketsClosedEmptyText: The list of permitted instruments for this site is empty — until something is added to it, no trading instruments are shown. The site owner makes the selection in the CMS.
home.marketsClosedUnavailableText: The site settings could not be retrieved, so no instruments are shown: access stays closed until the list arrives rather than opening up to everything. This is a failure and is fixed on the platform side.
home.marketsCatalogText: Instrument access is configured, but the market data service is not responding right now. The list will appear once the connection is restored.
home.marketsNoMatchText: Instruments are selected for this site, but none of them are currently quoted by the data source.
home.marketsNoTabsText: The Markets module is enabled, but all of its tabs are switched off in the site settings — there is nothing to show.
home.resetUnsetNote: Reset unavailable: the demo starting amount has not been set in the site settings.
home.resetUnavailableNote: Reset unavailable: the site settings could not be retrieved.
home.balanceNoAccountNote: The demo account opens on your first visit to the terminal — the terminal creates it, not the site.
home.resetAccepted: Accepted. The amount will update once the terminal applies the reset.
home.resetPositionsOpen: Close your open positions first: a reset with them would leave a balance from one life of the account and positions from another.
home.resetNotDemo: This is not a demo account — there is no starting amount to reset to.
home.resetRefused: The terminal refused the reset. The reason is in the log.
home.resetUnavailable: The terminal is unavailable, the reset was not sent. Try again later.
home.resetTooOften: Too often. Wait a minute and press again.
home.resetNoSession: Your session has expired — sign in again.
home.realFrozen: Account frozen: trading and withdrawals are closed; you can still close positions.
